breakdown.description: The rod is described as free to expand but the constrained-rod thermal stress formula is applied.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removed the contradictory 'free to expand' condition and correctly specified 'a fully constrained steel rod,' which is the appropriate boundary condition for using the formula σ = EαΔT. This matches the ground truth's guidance that the constrained-rod formula requires the rod to be fixed at both ends.
